title: Ambiguous Examples Help, But Full Data Wins: Revisiting Dataset Cartography for Extractive Adversarial QA
abstract: arXiv:2611.19763v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Dataset cartography argues that training dynamics can reveal regions of a dataset that matter differently for learning: easy-to-learn examples aid optimization, hard-to-learn examples often expose annotation problems, and ambiguous examples contribute strongly to out-of-distribution generalization. A striking implication of the original work is that a model trained on only 33% ambiguous examples can outperform full-data training on several OOD evaluations, including a QNLI reformulation of SQuAD evaluated on Adversarial SQuAD. We revisit this claim in a stricter setting: open-ended extractive question answering, where models must predict answer spans rather than classify question-sentence pairs. For each encoder family, we compute clean-source SQuAD training dynamics, train on full, random, easy-ranked, ambiguous-ranked, and hard-ranked subsets, and evaluate robustness on adversarial-only AddSent and AddOneSent rows. Ambiguous-ranked 33%

translated_title: 模糊样本有帮助，但全量数据更胜一筹：重新审视数据集制图法在抽取式对抗问答中的应用
translated_abstract: 数据集制图法（Dataset Cartography）认为，训练动态可以揭示数据集中对学习具有不同作用的区域：易学样本有助于优化过程，难学样本往往暴露标注问题，而模糊样本对分布外泛化的贡献最大。原始工作的一个引人注目的结论是，仅在33%模糊样本上训练的模型可以在多项分布外（OOD）评估中超越全量数据训练的模型，其中包括在Adversarial SQuAD上评估的SQuAD的QNLI重构版本。我们在一个更严格的设置下重新审视这一结论：开放式抽取式问答，即模型必须预测答案片段，而不是对“问题-句子”对进行分类。针对每个编码器系列，我们计算干净来源SQuAD的训练动态，分别在全量、随机、按易学排序、按模糊排序和按难学排序的子集上进行训练，并在仅包含对抗样本的AddSent和AddOneSent行上评估鲁棒性。按模糊排序选取的33%子集……（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: 本文在更严格的抽取式对抗问答设置下重新审视数据集制图法的结论，发现仅用33%模糊样本子集训练虽有帮助，但仍不敌全量数据训练在对抗性评估中的表现。
en_tdlr: Revisiting dataset cartography under the stricter setting of open-ended extractive adversarial QA, this paper shows that while ambiguous-ranked 33% subsets help, full-data training still wins on adversarial evaluations.
